scheme_name: State Reward to the Recipient of National Award
other_conditions: Must be a Goan artist who has received any of the specified National or International awards listed in the eligibility text.
Living artists who have already received such awards are eligible.
The benefit can be received only once per artist, even if the artist holds multiple awards.
benefits_summary: A memento, a certificate of appreciation, and a financial purse of ₹1,00,000 per individual.
